preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) in the input is a valid pair of distinct vertices between 1 and n.
The input contains exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.
The input edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree), where is_tree checks connectivity and acyclicity.

postconditions.description: The number of transformations k is a non-negative integer not exceeding 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= y_prime <= n and x != y and x != y_prime and y != y_prime for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation (x, y, y') consists of three distinct vertices x, y, y' in the range 1 to n.
Every transformation in the sequence is valid: (x, y) exists in the current tree, the graph remains a tree after deletion and addition, and |Vx| > |Vy| holds for the split components.

The sequence of transformations leads to a tree where the sum of squared distances between all pairs of vertices is minimized, where optimal_sum_of_squared_distances(n) is the minimal possible sum for any tree with n vertices.
The output contains exactly k transformations, matching the first line of output.
